title: The Goblin Who Talked | Nat 20 Pixels C1E2
description:
One goblin survived last night's raid on Brindle Cross. He has been tied to a rain barrel all night, and he hasn't said a word.
This morning, someone is going to make him talk: with a loaf of bread, or with a very large dwarf.

Episode 2 of a daily pixel-art D&D 5e story. Oriel and Brannoc question their captive outside the Crooked Kettle, Ilsevel tries to read a goblin's face for the first time, and Tamsin finds out that the Professor notices more than she lets on. Every check is decided by real, seeded dice shown on screen: no rerolls, no fudging.

New episode every weekday. Characters, quotes and every roll are on the wiki.

short.title: Interrogating a goblin with a loaf of bread | Nat 20 Pixels
short.description: Brannoc wants answers. Oriel brings breakfast. One persuasion roll decides whether the goblin talks.
